provenance.commit_note: main HEAD on 2026-09-04; reachable from main by construction. Replaces the unreachable-commit medians (sov-ezf).
provenance.adapter: AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (RADV NAVI32), Mesa 26.2.1-arch3.1, 1280x720, debug profile
provenance.quiescence: No concurrent GPU load. Two extra runs showed a uniform ~1.16-1.35x slowdown across ALL nine passes (clock/contention drift, not a code effect) and were excluded; a code regression cannot scale every pass uniformly while the scene is fixed.
provenance.tree_note: engine/, engine_demo/ and tools/ held in-flight sibling changes at record time (capture record plumbing only: present_mode Option, windowed-capture cfg, h4y sample bound; none touch render passes, resolutions, or the timing window). The medians below are the per-pass median of the three quiet run-medians.

tolerance_rule: tolerance(pass) = max(3 * measured_spread_fraction(pass), 0.15). measured_spread_fraction is each pass's own run-to-run median range over the three quiet provenance runs, divided by its baseline median.
tolerance_rationale: Quiescent run-to-run spread is 0.0-2.3% depending on the pass (main is noisiest at 2.3%, so 3x would give 6.8%). The 0.15 floor covers unmeasured quiescent-machine rerun variance with about 6x margin while staying about 2x below the 29% ssao regression the gate must catch (sov-70h): every pass fails a 29% move, and ordinary rerun noise (+-2%) passes everywhere. Gate runs need a quiet GPU; on failure, re-run quiet before blaming code. Replaces the old global 0.30 justified from the main pass alone.
rank_note: The old [depth_prepass, background] pair is dropped: the two passes sit within noise of each other (18.32 vs 18.56us) and their order already flipped between baselines. Kept pairs have 15%+ margins and uniform environmental scaling cannot reorder them.
